title: It’s great to be back at ACS for 2026
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
It’s great to be back at ACS!


Join our CTO, Dr Daniel Wigh, on Wednesday morning in Room W194a at 8:05-8:20 am where he'll be giving a talk on how we at ReactWise use transfer learning strategies to speed up reaction optimization.


He’ll describe in detail how we’re using the datasets we generated in our own lab are used with MemoryBO to offer our clients great speed-ups when doing coupling chemistry, and also reveal some exciting news about our new kinetics tool!
